sections.brief: Documented Israeli intelligence activity against the US (Pollard and the CIA damage assessment; NUMEC as unresolved; NSA 2008/2013 assessments; WSJ 2015 Iran talks with Israel's denial; Politico 2019 devices; Pegasus 2021; DIA 2026 report), the reverse collection on Netanyahu, and what the US gets. Figures: time

What US oversight cannot see: the 2009 raw-SIGINT memorandum's unenforceable terms and secret agreements, post-Oct 7 sharing and self-certification, NSM-20, the Israel Leahy Vetting Forum and the OIG backlog, the foreign-press ban. Figures: flow

Why follow-up is rare (classification, anonymous sources and denials, litigation limits, closed ground; interpretation labelled), links to PRESS and Gaza coverage sections, and the closing table of what flows to Israel, what flows back and what the US can see. Figures: compare
